en: Salah al-Din Khalil ibn Aybak al-Safadi
ar: صلاح الدين خليل بن أيبك الصفدي

description.tr: Arapçadaki en büyük biyografik sözlüğü 14.000+ maddeyle derledi || İbn Hallikân ve Zehebî'nin yöntemlerine dayanarak biyografi geleneğini benzersiz bir ölçeğe taşıdı. || [Tarih notu] Vâfî hâlâ tahkik ve neşir edilmektedir.
description.en: Compiled the largest biographical dictionary in Arabic, with 14,000+ entries — an unmatched prosopographical resource for medieval Islamic civilization || Building on Ibn Khallikan's Wafayat and al-Dhahabi's methods, al-Safadi expanded the biographical tradition to unprecedented scale, including scholars, poets, rulers, and artisans. || [Historiographical note] The Wafi is still being edited and published. Its scale makes it both the most important and least-accessible of medieval biographical dictionaries.
description.ar: جمع أكبر قاموس تراجم في العربية بأكثر من 14,000 ترجمة || بنى على منهج ابن خلكان والذهبي ووسع التقليد التراجمي إلى نطاق غير مسبوق
